claims.text: Inhaled bronchodilators (sometimes glucocorticoids for responders); USU pancreatic enzymes and vit supp.
claims.quote: Inhaled bronchodilators and sometimes corticosteroids (glucocorticoids) for responders Usually pancreatic enzyme and vitamin supplementation

claims.text: Daily long-term inhaled dornase alfa or 7% hypertonic saline: slows lung-function decline and ↓exacerbations.
claims.quote: Long-term daily inhalation therapy with dornase alfa (recombinant human deoxyribonuclease) or with 7% hypertonic saline is recommended (1, 2); it slows the rate of decline in pulmonary function and decreases the frequency of respiratory tract exacerbations (3).
claims.locator: Treatment of Cystic Fibrosis › Treatment of respiratory manifestations

claims.text: CFTR modulators (a potentiator, or correctors + a potentiator) for specific variants;
claims.quote: In patients with specific variants, CFTR modulators consisting of a CFTR potentiator or combination of CFTR correctors and a CFTR potentiator

claims.text: they cover ~90% of variants (⍉class I frameshift or nonsense).
claims.quote: CFTR corrector and potentiator medications (especially triple combination therapy) are indicated for approximately 90% of the variants carried by patients with CF. CFTR modulators are not available for patients with class I frameshift and nonsense mutations.
claims.locator: Treatment of Cystic Fibrosis › CFTR modulators

claims.text: Infect prophylaxis: pertussis, Hib, varicella, pneumococcal and measles immunity; annual flu vax.
claims.quote: In the United States, prophylaxis against pulmonary infections involves maintenance of pertussis, Haemophilus influenzae, varicella, Streptococcus pneumoniae, and measles immunity; annual influenza vaccination; and appropriate COVID-19 vaccination.
claims.locator: Treatment of Cystic Fibrosis › Treatment of respiratory manifestations
